node_notes.uart: USART2 connects the firmware output to the board Virtual COM Port. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c binds TX to PA2 and RX to PA3.
node_notes.oledsvc: This service refreshes the dashboard from a snapshot of current climate and motion values. The application calls oled_service_refresh in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.motionport: This adapter connects MPU6050 driver register callbacks to the shared I2C bus. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_motion.c provides motion_port_init and motion_port_read_acceleration.
node_notes.motion: The motion service supplies readings to the application and is retried when unavailable. Its setup and polling are invoked by firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.mpu: The MPU6050 supplies motion data and is accessed using its configured seven-bit address. firmware/configs/app_config.h sets that address to 0x68.
node_notes.led: LD4 is the board indicator driven by the application alert state. firmware/configs/app_config.h assigns PA5 and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_indicator.c writes that pin.
node_notes.ledport: The indicator adapter configures the LED output and writes its logical state using HAL_GPIO_WritePin. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_indicator.c binds that output to PA5.
node_notes.uartport: This adapter initializes USART2 and transmits bytes with HAL_UART_Transmit. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c assigns PA2 and PA3 as USART2 alternate-function pins.
node_notes.logger: This is the project logging sink used for status and error output. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c forwards logger writes to platform_uart2_write.
node_notes.shdriver: The SH1106 driver renders text and flushes framebuffer chunks through its write callback. Its implementation is firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c.
node_notes.timer: TIM3 provides the free-running microsecond counter used to measure DHT22 edge timing. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c configures its prescaler for a 1 MHz counter.
node_notes.i2cbus: I2C1 is the shared bus used by the motion sensor and OLED. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c configures PB8 as SCL and PB9 as SDA.
node_notes.dhtport: This adapter changes PB4 between input and open-drain low drive and captures the DHT22 frame. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c uses HAL GPIO calls and TIM3 counter reads.
node_notes.climate: The climate service owns initialization and polling of the DHT22 reading. app_start invokes its init and poll APIs in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.app: This foreground coordinator starts telemetry and initializes the services before repeatedly polling them. Its orchestration and direct motion and climate telemetry writes are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.i2cport: The STM32 I2C adapter serializes transfers and invokes HAL I2C APIs for bus operations. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c configures I2C1 and PB8/PB9.
node_notes.oledport: This adapter prefixes OLED command or data control bytes and forwards writes to the shared I2C bus. Its implementation is firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_oled.c.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 shares its bidirectional data line on PB4, which the adapter drives low and then reads. firmware/configs/app_config.h declares PB4 as APP_DHT22_DATA_PIN.
node_notes.alert: This policy retains and times motion-event indications, including the LED blink state. app_poll_services uses alert_indicator_update in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.oled: The SH1106 display receives command and framebuffer data over the shared I2C bus. firmware/configs/app_config.h sets its address to 0x3C.
node_notes.telemetry: Generated telemetry is started with the UART handle and polled by the foreground application. Those calls are in firmware/app/app.c, and the USART2 handle accessor is in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c.

node_notes.scan: The application scans legal I2C addresses and reports the responding devices. app_report_i2c_scan is called during startup in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.sample: The application polls motion data and reports a reading when the motion service returns a usable status. This path is in app_poll_services in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.polltelemetry: The foreground loop services generated telemetry before polling the application services. firmware/app/app.c calls firmgen_telemetry_poll in its app_start loop.
node_notes.init: Startup initializes climate acquisition, the LED indicator, OLED state, and motion acquisition. These initializations are performed in app_start in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.climateerror: Unexpected climate failures invalidate the reading and are logged, while not-due and not-ready results are ignored. This handling is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.delay: The foreground loop delays by APP_MOTION_IDLE_DELAY_MS before starting its next iteration. The delay is in app_start and the configured value is in firmware/configs/app_config.h.
node_notes.climatepoll: The application polls the climate service on each foreground pass, while the service enforces its sampling cadence. The call is in app_poll_services in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.retryinit: This step attempts motion service initialization and records the result for later retry scheduling. app_try_initialize_motion is implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.enter: This step starts generated telemetry and initializes the shared I2C bus before application services are brought up. The calls are in app_start in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.climatereport: A valid climate reading is logged and formatted for UART telemetry. app_report_climate is implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ready: This branch determines whether motion polling can proceed. The application tracks this state with app_motion_ready in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.retry: This branch checks whether motion is unavailable and its retry interval has elapsed. The retry condition is in app_poll_services in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.acknowledge: A pending event is logged and acknowledged so the service can clear it. app_poll_services performs both operations in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.climateok: This branch distinguishes a successful climate reading from not-due, not-ready, and error results. The status handling is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.event: This branch checks whether the motion reading contains pending events. The pending_events check is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.display: The application builds a snapshot and asks the OLED service to refresh it. app_poll_oled and its caller are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.alert: The application updates the alert policy and writes the indicator only when its requested LED state changes. The alert update and indicator_port_set call are in firmware/app/app.c.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as STM32 entry
  participant App as app_start
  participant Telemetry as generated telemetry
  participant I2C as I2C1 HAL adapter
  participant Bus as I2C1 PB8 and PB9
  participant Climate as climate service
  participant DHT as DHT22 adapter and sensor
  participant Timer as TIM3 edge timer
  participant Motion as motion service and adapter
  participant MPU as MPU6050
  participant Display as OLED service and SH1106
  participant LED as LD4 indicator
  participant Logger as logger
  participant UART as USART2 Virtual COM

  Boot->>App: call app_start
  App->>Telemetry: start with firmgen_uart_handle
  App->>I2C: initialize I2C1 and scan addresses
  I2C->>Bus: configure PB8 SCL and PB9 SDA
  I2C->>Bus: probe addresses 0x08 through 0x77
  App->>Climate: initialize climate service
  Climate->>DHT: initialize PB4 data line
  DHT->>Timer: start TIM3 microsecond counter
  App->>LED: initialize indicator output on PA5
  App->>Display: initialize OLED state
  App->>Motion: initialize motion service
  Motion->>I2C: read and configure MPU6050 registers
  I2C->>MPU: access address 0x68

  loop Foreground iteration with 1 ms idle delay
    App->>Telemetry: poll generated telemetry
    alt Motion unavailable and retry interval elapsed
      App->>Motion: retry motion service initialization
      Motion->>I2C: configure MPU6050
      I2C->>MPU: register transactions at 0x68
    else Motion service ready
      App->>Motion: poll for a due sample
      Motion->>I2C: read acceleration registers when due
      I2C->>MPU: burst read at 0x68
      MPU-->>Motion: acceleration sample
      opt Motion event pending
        Motion-->>App: reading and pending event
        App->>Motion: acknowledge event
      end
    end
    App->>LED: update alert state and set changed output
    App->>Climate: poll for a due reading
    opt Climate sample due
      Climate->>DHT: start request and capture data on PB4
      DHT->>Timer: measure response and bit pulse widths
      DHT-->>Climate: decoded temperature and humidity or error
      App->>Logger: log climate result
      Logger->>UART: transmit log through USART2
    end
    App->>Display: refresh dashboard snapshot
    Display->>I2C: send SH1106 commands and data
    I2C->>Bus: transfer to OLED at 0x3C
    App->>UART: transmit motion telemetry when due
  end
